title: LinkedIn Hashtag & Topic Post Tracker Input
description: Find top public LinkedIn posts that contain a given hashtag or topic. No cookie or login needed. Provide one or more hashtags (with or without leading #), or topic slugs.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: LinkedIn hashtags to track. Leading '#' optional. Examples: 'ai', '#martech', 'devrel', 'fintech'.

topicSlugs.title: Topic slugs
topicSlugs.description: Optional LinkedIn topic page slugs from linkedin.com/pulse/topics/{slug}. Examples: 'artificial-intelligence', 'leadership-development'.

maxPostsPerHashtag.title: Max posts per hashtag
maxPostsPerHashtag.description: Hard cap on posts returned per hashtag or topic. Set to 0 to take everything discoverable in the search depth window.

postedLimitDate.title: Earliest post date
postedLimitDate.description: Skip posts older than this date. ISO format YYYY-MM-DD or Unix epoch ms. Leave blank to take everything.

minReactions.title: Minimum reactions
minReactions.description: Only return posts with at least this many reactions. Use to filter out low signal posts. Set to 0 to take everything.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: How to order returned posts per hashtag.

searchDepth.title: Search depth
searchDepth.description: Number of search result pages to walk per hashtag. Higher depth finds more posts but uses more proxy traffic.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Six is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
